scope: Focused offline review of preserved records and current Owner PWA source only; no device, build, restart, OTA, deployment, or long diagnostic.
verified_caveats: R7 and R4 telemetry are cumulative histogram snapshots; they are not independent non-overlapping samples.

R7 used a materially denser direct-to-device HTTP sampler than R4 and R2. Existing live telemetry reads five direct Matrix/AUX endpoints per poll; R7 sampled about every 1.2 seconds, R4 about every 2.2 seconds, and R2 every 8 seconds.
Assuming the recorded five endpoint reads per poll are counted equally, the R7 sampler request cadence was about 1.8x R4 and 6.25x R2; this is a rate comparison, not a measured load or causal effect.
R7 host-read elapsed times were typically about 0.1-0.2 seconds. They include end-to-end request timing, not measured ESP32 CPU time spent serializing JSON.
R7 frame histograms contain no timestamped request begin/end events correlated with frame IDs. Therefore the tails cannot be matched to HTTP/JSON work.
R2 ran at substantially lower uptime than the R7 tail-onset period and had unequal cumulative histogram populations; its lower p99 does not disprove the R7 failure.

The visible Owner page schedules both the `hbnf-cart-control` status request and a separate `hbnf-cart-visual-status` request when `refresh()` runs, every 6 seconds while visible and idle. It also refreshes `live_status` about every 30 seconds. These are Supabase HTTPS endpoints; the UI itself contains no direct Matrix `/json/state` or `/json/info` call in that loop.

The checked-in backend source shows `hbnf-cart-control` status as a canonical database read and `live_status` as a league-state read. The implementation of the deployed `hbnf-cart-visual-status` function is not in this checkout, so whether that endpoint performs an indirect device/MQTT read is unresolved.

The scoring module reads on entry/manual refresh and after a save; it has no periodic score polling. Direct Matrix `/json/info` use is in the local diagnostics/preflight path, not the normal hosted Owner PWA status loop.

causality.http_json_load_could_contribute: POSSIBLE: the direct Matrix sampler cadence differs materially. Each request requires WLED to handle an HTTP endpoint and produce JSON. This is a technically plausible source of CPU/network contention.
causality.sampler_cadence_explains_p99_difference: NOT ESTABLISHED: p99 snapshots have no request-to-frame correlation; actual device serialization time is not measured; R4/R7 cumulative sample windows and runtime ages differ.
causality.normal_owner_pwa_has_comparable_direct_m: NO direct Matrix polling is present in the checked-in Owner UI refresh loop; two Supabase endpoint requests run each six-second refresh. Whether the deployed visual-status function performs indirect device polling is unknown because its source is absent here, and no live request trace was available.
causality.final_firmware_decision: Original R7 p99 gate failure remains valid. Current evidence cannot distinguish a realistic-use firmware regression from a high-rate observer interaction or their interaction. Do not claim the R2 result resolves it.
causality.normal_owner_pwa_polling_comparability: INCOMPLETE: client request cadence is known from source; deployed visual-status backend behavior and actual network request rates were not measured.

sources.path: deployed hbnf-cart-visual-status source not present in checkout; no backend polling claim made

sources.title: WLED JSON API
sources.material_fact: WLED exposes its state/info through an HTTP JSON API; an HTTP read requires the device to handle and serialize a JSON response.

sources.title: WLED WebSocket
sources.material_fact: WLED documents /ws state push without polling. The same documentation says the endpoint is ws:// only and browsers disallow ws:// from HTTPS pages, so a hosted HTTPS Owner PWA cannot adopt it directly without a separate secure proxy.

decision: No 10+10-minute diagnostic is requested or initiated. Firmware work remains paused at R4. A future test is needed only if firmware performance attribution must be closed; current software RC work does not depend on that attribution.
